name: lifeos
description: LifeOS core: the /lifeos router, the one LifeOS MCP connection, shared rules, a verify agent, guard recipes and the feed, knowledge and money skills (knowledge and money off by default). Module plugins (work, device, entity, self) add the rest; every owner fact comes from your own LifeOS.
